translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Daawite Asaa Paydina YeeddaS'oossaa Hank'k'uwaa
Sees'aanay Israa'eeliyaa bolla metuwaa ahanaw koyiide, Daawite Israa'eeliyaa asaa paydanaadan dentsetseedda.
Daawite Yoo'aabanne olanchchatuu kaappatuwaa hawaadan yaageedda; «Daanappe Berssaabeha gakkanaw biite; Israa'eeliyaa asaa paydite. Yaatiide asaa paydu aappunentto taana erissite» yaageedda.

Shin Yoo'aabe Aa, «Med'inaa Goday ha de'iyaa bare asaa bolla s'eetu kushiyaa gujjo! Ta godaw, kaatiyaw, unttunttu ubbay ta godaa k'oomatuwaa gidikkinooyye? Ta goday hewaa malaa ootsanaw ayaw koyii? Israa'eeliyaa kawutetsaa ayaw bayzanchcha kessii?» yaageedda.
Shin kaatiyaa k'aalay Yoo'aaba s'ooneedda. Yoo'aabe kesiide, Israa'eeliyaa biittaa ubbaa yuuyyeedda; Yerusaalame simmeedda.

Yoo'aabe paydeedda asaa payduwaa Daawitaw immeedda. Israa'eeliyaa biittan ubbaan mashshaan olettanaw danddayiyaa itti miilonenne itti s'eetu sha"a mino asatuu de'iino. K'ay Yihudaa biittan mashshaan olettanaw danddayiyaa oyddu s'eetanne laappun tammu sha"a mino asatuu de'iino.
Yoo'aabe kaatiyaa azazuwaa sheneteedda diraw, Leewatuwaanne Biiniyaama zeretsaa payduwaan gujjibeenna.
S'oossay ha yewuwaan nashettibeenna diraw, Israa'eeliyaa mureedda.
Yaatina Daawite S'oossaa, «Taani ha kiitan wolk'k'aama nagaraa ootsaad. Shin ha"i neena woossay; ta bayzuwaa, ne k'oomaa bayzuwaa k'uc'c'a. Taani daro eeyyabaa hanaad» yaageedda.
Med'inaa Goday Daawitaw timbbitiyaa odiyaa Gaada hawaadan yaagiide haasayisseedda;
«Baade; Daawita, ‹Med'inaa Goday neena, «Taani neena heezzubaappe dooruwaa bessay; taani ne bolla polanaw taw unttuttuppe ittuwaa doora» yaagee› yaaga» yaageedda.

Gaadi Daawitakko biide Aa, «Med'inaa Goday neena, ‹Hawanttuppe ittuwaa doora: heezzu laytsaa koshaa dooray? Woy ne morkketuu neena yederssishin, heezzu aginaa unttunttu sintsaappe bak'atanawaa dooray? Woy Med'inaa Godaa mashshay ne gadiyaa heezzu gallassaa shoc'anawaanne hewaanakka k'ay Israa'eeliyaa gadiyaa pini kesanaashin hayk'k'uwaa iita harggiyaan shoc'iyaa kiitanchchaa I kiittiyaawaa dooray?› yaagee. Ane ha"i k'achchaade, taani taana kiitteeddawoo zaariyaawaa oda» yaageedda.
Daawite Gaada, «Taani loytsi un"ettaad. Med'inaa Godaa maarotetsay loytsi wolk'k'aama gidiyaa diraw, ane taani Aa kushiyan kunddana; taani asaa kushiyan kunddikke» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw, Med'inaa Goday Israa'eeliyaa bolla iita harggiyaa yeddina, laappun tammu sha"a Israa'eeliyaa asatuu hayk'k'eeddino.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Med'inaa Goday Yerusaalame bayzanaw kiitanchchaa kiitteedda. Shin kiitanchchay Yerusaalame bayzanaw mata utti de'ishshin, Med'inaa Goday yaatiide kayyotteedda. Kayyottiidde bayziyaa kiitanchchaa, «Agga! Hewe gidanawaa!» yaageedda. He wode S'oossaa kiitanchchay Yaabuusiyaa Ornna udduma matan ek'k'eedda.

Med'inaa Godaa Kiitanchchay bare mashshaa bare kushiyan oyk'k'iide, Yerusaalame bayzanaw sa'aappenne saluwaappe gidduwaan ek'k'eeddawaa Daawite be'eedda. Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Daawitenne c'imatuu waaruwaa mayyiide, barenttu deemuwaan guufanneeddino.

Daawite S'oossaa, «Asay paydettanaadan ootseeddawe taana gidikkitaayye? Naak'k'eeddawenne iitabaa ootseeddawe taana. Shin ha dorssatuu, unttunttu ayaa ootseeddino? Abeet Med'inaa Godaa, ta S'oossaw, hayyanaa ne kushii taananne ta aawuwaa soy asaa muro. Ne kushii ne asaa muroppo!» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Med'inaa Godaa kiitanchchay Gaade hawaadan yaagiide azazeedda; «Daawite pude Yaabuusiyaa Ornna udduma biide, Med'inaa Godaw yarshshiyaa sa'aa yaan gimbbanaadan oda» yaageedda.
Med'inaa Goday nabiyaa Gaade baggana geedda k'aalaadan Daawite beedda.
He wode Ornninne Aa oyddu attuma naanay uddumaan zarggaa bukkiino. Guyye simmi s'eelliide, kiitanchchaa be'eeddino; aanana de'iyaa naanay k'osetteeddinno.
Daawite Ornnakko yeedda wode, Ornni Aa be'iide, uddumaappe gas'aa kesiide, bare deemuwaa sa'aa gatsiide, Daawitaw goyneedda.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Daawite Ornna, «Boshay asaa bollappe kichchana mala, taani Med'inaa Godaw yarshshiyaa sa'aa kees's'anaw ne uddumma taw zal"aarikkii. Taani new kumentsaa gatiyaa c'iggana» yaageedda.

Ornni Daawita, «New akka; ta goday kaatii barena nashechchiyaawaa ootso. Be'a, s'uuggiyaa yarshshoo booraa, eetsanaw katsaa bukkiyaa miishshaanne katsaa yarshshoo zarggaa taani immana. Taani ha ubbaakka new immana» yaageedda.

Shin Kaatii Daawite Ornna, «tuytti, chii! Taani kumentsaa gatiyaa k'ans's'aade shammana. Ayaw gooppe, taani nebaa Med'inaa Godaw akkikke; k'ay taani miishshaa kessabeennawaa s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsaade yarshshikke» yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw, Daawite he uddumaw usuppun s'eetu work'k'aa santtimiyaa immeedda.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Daawite he koshiyan Med'inaa Godaw yarshshuwaa yarshshiyaa sa'aa kees's'eedda. Yaatiide s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaanne ittippetetsaa yarshshuwaa yarshsheedda; Med'inaa Godaa woossina, Med'inaa Goday s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa bolla saluwaappe tamaa yeddiide, aw zaareedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Med'inaa Goday kiitanchchaa azazina, kiitanchchay bare mashshaa shookoo zaareedda.
Daawite Med'inaa Goday Aa woosaw zaareeddawaa be'iide, Yaabuusiyaa Ornna uddumaan laa'entsuwaa yarshsheedda.
Muse mela biittaan giigisseedda Med'inaa Godaa Dunkkaaniinne s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa yarshshiyaa sa'ay he wode Gabaa'oonan goynniyaa d'ok'k'a sa'aan de'ee.
Shin Daawite Med'inaa Godaa kiitanchchaa mashshaw yayyeedda diraw, S'oossaa oochchanaw he sa'aa baanaw danddayibeenna.
